visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene is a brightly lit indoor hallway of a modern apartment. A woman is seen lying flat on the floor at the edge of a doorway, peeking her head out into the corridor. She wears a casual black outfit and looks towards the camera with a mischievous expression. Large white text with a black background is overlaid at the top of the frame. (2) A man dressed in a black oversized hoodie and black shorts enters the hallway from a door at the far end. He walks barefoot towards the camera, unaware of the woman on the floor. As he reaches the corner where she is hiding, she suddenly speaks to him. (3) The man jumps back in extreme surprise, his body tensing as he lets out a shout. He quickly realizes it was a prank and begins to laugh, leaning his head against the wall. The woman remains on the floor, laughing hysterically at his reaction. Subtitles appear at the bottom tracking their conversation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp, loud impact sound of a heavy door slamming shut resonates through the acoustic space. (2) This is followed by the rhythmic, soft thudding of bare footsteps on a hard tile surface. A male voice calls out "Bao Bao, wo hui lai le" (Baby, I'm back) with a calm, conversational pitch. (3) The footsteps continue for several seconds as the male repeats the call with slightly more rising intonation. (4) A sudden, dry female vocalization interjects, immediately followed by an explosive, high-arousal, and high-pitched scream from the male. (5) Sustained, loud, and breathy laughter from both speakers fills the mix, accompanied by rapid, playful verbal exchanges as the tension resolves into amusement.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to entertain the audience through a relatable and humorous domestic prank. By capturing the authentic, startled reaction of the boyfriend to the girlfriend's 'laying on the floor' prank, it leverages the 'jump scare' trope common in short-form comedy content.
